purpose: Roadmap 7: finite regression evidence, not a population win rate or universal balance certification.

hardInvariants: Input immutability; valid JSON saves before combat and after public transitions.
Finite nonnegative bounded HP/MP and supplies; no fixture stat/resource grants.
Only legally learned calling, owned equipped gear and recruited available companions.
No free unbounded self-refund exploit; explicit recovery turns and ally resource exchange remain legitimate costs/tradeoffs.
Preserve 11x11 connected reciprocal maze doors, fog, finite caches and actual stair exits.

bands.routine-road: A rested earned adult should have an approachable route. A new defeat merits review, not an automatic numerical nerf.
bands.hazardous-ruin: Resource expenditure and retreat are acceptable. Compare the same build and policy before claiming a cliff.
bands.procedural-current-tier: Tier transitions must be visible and investigated when outcomes or reserves shift materially. A stat jump alone is not a demonstrated cliff.
bands.named-guardian-risk: Dangerous solo outcomes are acceptable; support/defense should retain distinct resource exchanges. No universal-victory requirement.
bands.resource-carrying-expedition: Completion or an honest safe withdrawal both produce evidence. No route or reserve reset, free refill, hidden-map oracle or teleport.
